trigger.note: ST43 (paid base reel spin) triggers the FreeSpin feature via ReMarks='TriggerFreespin' (356/40000 in-sample). ST44 is the granted free reel spin (cost=0, ReMarks='FreeSpin'; re-trigger 'FreeSpinTriggerFreespin'). Both STs settle via their NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount payids — no synthesized pid needed. No live collect channel (no SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols).

validation.evidence: W1 (onboard-implementer, 2026-06-18; 80000 ST43 + 2373 ST44 rounds across 2 real _cache_version:3 chunks, single config bucket 1584da38/8067f1ba, _bet=1000): ST inventory = 2 SpinTypes, both STANDARD full-reel signature (StopSymbolsByCol+PayoutByPayline+PayoutIdToWinAmount+RewardLastNode+ReelSkin+ReMarks+WinCredits). ST43 role=paid_spin (CostCredits=1000, GameplayTriggerType=0, ReMarks empty except 'TriggerFreespin' x356 -> opens freespin); ST44 role=freespin (CostCredits=0 granted, ReMarks='FreeSpin' x1188 / 'FreeSpinTriggerFreespin' x33 re-trigger). FeatureWin taxonomy = {NormalFreeSpin, FreeSpin}. NO live-collect channel (SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols absent); RewardLastNode is a payline-node list mirroring the payid keys (e.g. ['12-','11-'] for pid {12,11}), NOT a ticking collect counter. EVERY win round carries a populated native PayoutIdToWinAmount -> ZERO win-without-payid -> no additive collect residual. CurJackpotStoreWin present on 100% of rounds but =0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed, fleet-wide behavior). Both STs supportable manifest-only via the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (paid_spin) + the existing freespin_dynamics plugin (freespin role, already validated/wired). No NEW plugin, no synth rule. rtp_integrity.paid_st=[43] (ST44 cost=0 excluded from RTP denominator). Awaiting onboard-tester + breaker + user domain sign-off (gate 8).
caveats: ST44 freespin per-round retrigger-depth / free-spin-count histogram needs per-round sequence accumulation in parser.py (base-closure) — freespin_dynamics surfaces the base-excluded aggregate; the depth histogram is parser_blind. Framework-team item (same per-ST-extraction boundary as M43 minigame node-list).

Per-skin (ReelSkin) labeled breakout is parser_blind: the plugin layer receives coarse per-ST RETURN_BUCKET histograms, not per-round ReelSkin (same boundary as M279 skin-11). The skin's CONTRIBUTION is captured (pooled into the per-ST multiplier distribution). Framework-team item IF a labeled per-skin metric is wanted.
validation.gate8_note: fleet T1/T2 batch gate-8 sign-off 2026-06-18: no out-of-engine mechanics declared beyond the fleet CurJackpotStoreWin test-interface-zeroing (and M90's gift, recorded). Objective gates 1-7 pass; mechanical independent-recompute breaker held.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST43/ST44 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records. FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): a real progressive jackpot store whose accumulation efficiency the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST43/ST44 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
